title: Window Replacement quote, real prices, under a minute
jobDescription:
Replacement of five existing single-glazed aluminium windows with new thermally broken double-glazed aluminium frames (Monument colour) and clear low-E glass (4mm clear / 12mm argon / 4mm low-E) at a residential property in Balmain, Sydney.
1. Living Room: One (1) sliding window, 2400mm (W) x 1800mm (H).
2. Bedroom 1: One (1) casement window, 1200mm (W) x 1200mm (H).
3. Bedroom 2: One (1) casement window, 1200mm (W) x 1200mm (H).
4. Bathroom: One (1) fixed frosted window, 600mm (W) x 900mm (H).
5. Kitchen: One (1) awning window, 900mm (W) x 900mm (H).
Scope includes removal of existing windows, supply and installation of new frames and glass, new internal architraves (primed pine), external flashing, sill trims, and sealant. Fly screens to be supplied and installed for all openable windows (Living Room, Bedroom 1, Bedroom 2, Kitchen).
workingDetail: New window frames (aluminium, timber, or uPVC), Double glazed glass units, Flashing and sill trims, Sealant and foam
